message: I have $10. Suggest chicken, vegetables and two beers.
review: Recommend menu items and explain total versus budget.

message: Tôi đi 4 người, nên ăn món gì?
review: Acknowledge four diners; ask about budget without inventing one.

message: Tôi ăn chay, gợi ý đậu phụ và rau với $8 nhé.
review: Do not guarantee vegetarian ingredients unless menu data verifies them.

message: Tôi dị ứng tôm. Cho tôi cơm và gà trong $12, tránh hải sản.
review: Mention allergy uncertainty and confirm ingredients with restaurant; do not promise safety.

message: Cho tôi mì và canh không cay, ngân sách $9.
review: Preserve non-spicy preference without inventing ingredient facts.

message: Recommend a dessert and a soft drink for $5.
review: Mention any missing category.

message: What's the cheapest beer?
review: Answer the price question rather than turning it into an order.

message: Where can I get grilled chicken feet?
review: Use actual menu matches; avoid claiming availability beyond dataset.

message: Are these restaurants open after midnight?
review: Admit when opening hours are absent from menu data.

message: Do these restaurants offer delivery to my hotel?
review: Do not invent delivery services or fees.

message: Cho tôi một phần cá và một cơm.
review: Show actual cost and invite a budget.

message: Tôi có ngân sách -10 USD, gợi ý món gà.
review: Ask for a valid positive budget; never silently replace -10 with 0.25.

message: Ngân sách +10 USD, cho tôi một món bò.
review: Accept an explicit positive sign.

message: Tôi có 0 USD, có thể gọi món gà gì?
review: Preserve zero and explain no priced meal fits; do not invent spending money.

message: Ngân sách của tôi là abc USD, cho tôi món gà.
review: Ask to restate abc as a number.

message: Cho tôi món bò, ngân sách 12abc USD.
review: Do not silently parse 12abc as 12.

message: Cho tôi cơm, ngân sách 1.2.3 USD.
review: Request a valid amount instead of guessing decimal separators.

message: Tôi có một ít tiền, gợi ý món heo nhé.
review: Distinguish vague money from no budget mention.

message: Recommend rice and an egg for $2.50.
review: Keep decimal precision and disclose if over budget.

message: ខ្ញុំមាន ៤១០០០ រៀល ចង់ញ៉ាំបាយ និងសាច់មាន់។
review: Recognize Khmer digits and apply fixed conversion.

message: Tôi có 254.000đ, gợi ý món cá và rau.
review: Interpret dot as Vietnamese thousands separator.

message: I have ₱587 for pork and rice. What should I order?
review: Use fixed PHP conversion, disclose approximation.

message: Suggest seafood and rice for SGD 13.40.
review: Do not treat SGD as USD.

message: Cho tôi -2 chai bia với $10.
review: Current quantity policy clamps to one; review whether clarification would be better.

message: Cho tôi +2 chai bia với $10.
review: Accept explicit plus on quantity.

message: Cho tôi abc chai bia với $10.
review: Current quantity policy defaults to one; ideally ask for clarification.

message: Cho tôi 999 chai bia, ngân sách $20.
review: Quantity is capped at ten; disclose this instead of implying 999 were priced.
